d: World leaders are reacting to the Democrats' sweeping victory in the 2026 US midterm elections, which saw the party seize control of both the House and Senate in a major setback for Donald Trump. From Europe to Africa and Latin America, leaders are weighing what the political shift means for America's global role. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas hopes the new Congress will strengthen support for Ukraine, while German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul sees an opportunity for renewed diplomatic efforts.
